## Discovery & Translational Science

- **Chemoproteomic discovery of a brain-penetrant covalent NLRP3 inhibitor** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42569816/)
  - Screening identified a brain-penetrant, covalent NLRP3 inhibitor.
  - The compound binds a newly identified allosteric pocket on the NLRP3 inflammasome.

- **[Biotech]** **Corvus Pharmaceuticals explores soquelitinib mechanism in allergic inflammation** [X / @HOThomasWPhelps](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2085839558005194946)
  - ITK inhibitor soquelitinib was shown to target the upstream ILC2 pathway in translational models of asthma and atopic dermatitis.

- **Polygenic risk score modifies LDL-C response to saturated fat intake** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.06.29.26356854)
  - An analysis of 20,940 postmenopausal women in the Women's Health Initiative identified a non-linear interaction between a genome-wide polygenic score for LDL-C (PGS-LDL) and dietary saturated fat intake (p-interaction = 0.01).
  - High saturated fat intake significantly increased LDL-C and ASCVD risk primarily in individuals with high PGS-LDL (HR 1.45, 95% CI 1.20–1.75; HR 1.29 after adjustment for baseline untreated LDL-C).

- **Conditional mutants identify vulnerable antimalarial drug targets** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42570799/)
  - Investigators used conditional loss-of-function mutant parasites to systematically identify essential proteins vulnerable to antimalarial inhibition.

- **MiR-485-5p targets RGS4 to drive angiogenesis in lower limb ischemia** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42570815/)
  - Preclinical findings show that miR-485-5p promotes localized blood vessel growth by targeting RGS4 and activating downstream VEGFR-2/AKT/ERK1/2 signaling.

- **PDLIM2 identified as a biomarker and target in lung adenocarcinoma** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42570967/)
  - Integrative analysis established PDLIM2 as a prognostic biomarker and potential target in lung adenocarcinoma.

- **Microneedle drug delivery system tested for allergic asthma** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42570969/)
  - A multi-component microneedle patch incorporating a sanfu herbal formulation was evaluated for transdermal delivery in a rat model of allergic asthma.

## Early Trials — Phase I–II

- **[Big Pharma]** **Novo Nordisk publishes Phase 2 subcutaneous zenagamtide data** [The Lancet / X](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2085839558005194946)
  - Phase 2 trial results for zenagamtide were published in *The Lancet*.
  - Discontinuations in the subcutaneous treatment arm were largely driven by gastrointestinal adverse events, specifically nausea and vomiting.

- **[Biotech]** **Incyte evaluates hearing loss in Phase 2 povorcitinib vitiligo trial** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42570211/)
  - A sub-study analyzed the prevalence and clinical characteristics of vitiligo-associated hearing loss among patients enrolled in a Phase 2 trial of the oral JAK1 inhibitor povorcitinib.

- **[Biotech]** **Revolution Medicines reports preliminary elironrasib combination responses** [X / @doepke_michel](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2085839558005194946)
  - An elironrasib combination cohort achieved 2 complete responses (CRs) across 39 evaluated patients.
  - Clinical trial access for investigational RAS inhibitor daraxonrasib is expanding across U.S. study sites.

- **[Big Pharma]** **Eli Lilly expands combination strategy across inflammatory diseases** [X / @DrSamuelBHume](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2085839558005194946)
  - Lilly is broadening its combination trial framework across clinical programs in Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis, and related inflammatory conditions.

- **Multicenter trial compares chemoradiation regimens in newly diagnosed glioblastoma** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42570798/)
  - A randomized trial evaluated survival and toxicity outcomes of ultra-hypofractionated versus standard conventional chemoradiation in patients with newly diagnosed glioblastoma.

- **SCOUT trial data debate highlights nitrofurantoin efficacy over fosfomycin** [The Lancet](https://www.thelancet.com/journals/lancet/article/PIIS0140-6736(26)01324-3/fulltext?rss=yes)
  - In a trial of 768 women with uncomplicated cystitis, a 5-day course of nitrofurantoin achieved clinical resolution rates 34.9 percentage points higher (95% CI 22.9–46.8) than single-dose fosfomycin and 22.7 percentage points higher (95% CI 10.3–35.1) than two-dose fosfomycin among culture-positive participants.

## Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

- **[Biotech]** **Commentary evaluates ralinepag role in pulmonary arterial hypertension** [The Lancet](https://www.thelancet.com/journals/lancet/article/PIIS0140-6736(26)01556-4/fulltext?rss=yes)
  - A commentary highlights the evolving PAH treatment landscape, emphasizing the clinical need for oral prostacyclin receptor agonists like ralinepag to improve outcomes in lower-risk and combination-therapy settings.

## Regulatory & Approvals

- **[Biotech]** **Larimar Therapeutics initiates rolling BLA submission** [X / @BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2085839558005194946)
  - Larimar has begun a rolling BLA submission seeking accelerated approval for its lead candidate, supported by a $156 million cash position.

- **[Biotech]** **Ultragenyx prepares for regulatory and late-stage trial readouts in 2H26** [X / @DeepSouthDoctor](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2085839558005194946)
  - Ultragenyx has two PDUFA action dates and key Phase 2b/3 trial readouts scheduled for the second half of 2026.

## Business & Strategy

- **[Biotech]** **Transcenta sells CDMO assets to WuXi Biologics for RMB 190M** [X / @chuminhua432](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2085839558005194946)
  - Transcenta agreed to divest its CDMO manufacturing infrastructure to WuXi Biologics for RMB 190 million (~$26 million) to focus resources on core biopharmaceutical R&D.

- **[Biotech]** **Sangamo Therapeutics assets move to Chapter 11 auction** [X / @Franca_ole](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2085839558005194946)
  - A Chapter 11 bankruptcy auction is underway to evaluate and monetize Sangamo's zinc-finger gene-editing and viral delivery platforms.

- **[Biotech]** **ReCode Therapeutics announces CFTR gene-editing deal** [X / @yaireinhorn](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2085839558005194946)
  - ReCode disclosed a new collaboration focused on CFTR gene editing for cystic fibrosis, with market speculation pointing to Prime Medicine as the undisclosed partner.

- **[Biotech]** **Ardelyx lowers 2026 IBSRELA revenue guidance** [X / @Pharmdca](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2085839558005194946)
  - Ardelyx reduced its 2026 revenue guidance for IBSRELA to $350–$370 million and withdrew its long-term financial guidance for XPHOZAH.

- **[Biotech]** **Revolution Medicines target prices raised across Wall Street** [X / BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2086073932562432253)
  - Analysts raised price targets for Revolution Medicines following clinical updates, including Needham, Guggenheim, and Wells Fargo ($240), Evercore and Oppenheimer ($230), and JPMorgan ($227).

- **[Biotech]** **Madrigal Pharmaceuticals upgraded at Wolfe Research** [X / @WallStSai](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2085839558005194946)
  - Wolfe Research upgraded Madrigal Pharmaceuticals to Outperform with a price target of $600.

## Public Health & Policy

- **Uganda controls Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak** [The Lancet](https://www.thelancet.com/journals/lancet/article/PIIS0140-6736(26)01594-1/fulltext?rss=yes)
  - Health authorities in Uganda successfully stopped local transmission of the Bundibugyo Ebola virus, though cross-border risk remains high due to active transmission in the neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo.

- **Anti-LGBTQ legislation in Senegal impairs HIV service delivery** [The Lancet](https://www.thelancet.com/journals/lancet/article/PIIS0140-6736(26)01595-3/fulltext?rss=yes)
  - Harsh legal penalties for same-sex relations in Senegal have driven patients away from healthcare facilities, severely disrupting local HIV prevention and treatment programs.

- **Romania confronts endemic measles resurgence** [The Lancet](https://www.thelancet.com/journals/lancet/article/PIIS0140-6736(26)01596-5/fulltext?rss=yes)
  - Measles has become endemic in Romania following sustained drops in childhood vaccination coverage, prompting targeted public health interventions by the National Institute of Public Health.

- **Lancet correspondence challenges Global Burden of Disease 2023 methodology** [The Lancet](https://www.thelancet.com/journals/lancet/article/PIIS0140-6736(26)00043-7/fulltext?rss=yes)
  - Researchers criticized the GBD 2023 study for omitting armed conflict as a distinct risk factor despite a 40% increase in civilian conflict deaths in 2024, while separate letters noted long-standing methodological gaps in estimating physical inactivity and WASH-related mortality.
